$comment: Prose that cannot be introspected from the source. Tags, attributes, slots and events are derived from the code itself; test/manifest/metadata.test.mjs fails when this file and the code disagree in either direction.

attributes.readonly: Renders the control but does not let it be edited. A readonly field still contributes its value to the form.
attributes.required: Marks the field as required for assistive technologies and shows the required marker on its label.
attributes.placeholder: Placeholder shown while the field is empty.

slots.info: Extra content rendered next to the label, for a hint or a help icon.
slots.ibefore: An addon rendered inside the input group, before the control.
slots.iafter: An addon rendered inside the input group, after the control.
slots.before: Content rendered before the control, outside the addon styling.
slots.after: Content rendered after the control, outside the addon styling.

ful-spinner.description: A busy indicator. ful-form shows and hides the ones it contains while submitting.

slots.default: Text shown next to the spinner.

ful-form.description: Wraps its content in a form, collects the values of the fields it contains and hands them to a loader on submit.

events.submit: Cancelable. Fired before anything is sent: preventDefault aborts the submit.
events.submit:requested: Fired after the submit was accepted, to let a listener resolve the response itself.
events.submit:success: Fired with the submitted values and the mapped response.
events.submit:failure: Fired with the exception when the submit fails. The form does not rethrow.

ful-checkbox.description: A checkbox, or a switch with type="switch".

attributes.value: Checked when the attribute is the string true.

events.change: Fired with the new checked state when the box or its label is clicked.

ful-input.description: A labelled text input. Use type to pick any native input type, or textarea.

events.change: Fired with the current value when the field is committed.

ful-input-file.description: A file input with an optional dropzone and a list of the selected files, enforcing the size and count limits it declares.

attributes.value: Only an empty value is honoured, to clear the selection: file inputs cannot be filled programmatically.
attributes.accept: Comma separated list of accepted extensions. Files that do not match are dropped with a warning.
attributes.multiple: Allows selecting more than one file.
attributes.itemlist: Shows the list of selected files.
attributes.maxfiles: Maximum number of files. Exceeding it clears the selection.
attributes.maxfilesize: Maximum size of a single file, in bytes. Larger files are dropped.
attributes.maxtotalsize: Maximum size of all the selected files, in bytes. Exceeding it clears the selection.

slots.dropzone: Replaces the contents of the default dropzone.

events.change: Fired with the names of the selected files.

ful-local-date.description: Formats the date in its content, written as yyyy-mm-dd, in the locale of the page.

ful-instant.description: Formats the ISO instant in its content in the locale and timezone of the page.

ful-input-local-date.description: A date input. Its bounds accept a date, now, or an offset such as +1d, -2m or +3y.

attributes.min: Earliest selectable date. Accepts a date, now, or a day, month or year offset.
attributes.max: Latest selectable date. Accepts a date, now, or a day, month or year offset.
attributes.step: Step between selectable dates, in days.

ful-input-local-time.description: A time input. Its bounds accept a time, now, or an hour or minute offset, snapped to the step grid.

attributes.min: Earliest selectable time. Accepts a time, now, or an offset such as +2h or -30m.
attributes.max: Latest selectable time. Accepts a time, now, or an offset such as +2h or -30m.
attributes.step: Step between selectable times, in seconds. The bounds are truncated to this grid.

ful-input-instant.description: A datetime input whose value is read and written as an ISO instant.

attributes.min: Earliest selectable instant, as an ISO instant.
attributes.max: Latest selectable instant, as an ISO instant.
attributes.step: Step between selectable instants, in seconds.

ful-radio-group.description: A group of radios, declared as ful-radio children. With type="boolean" the value is a real boolean.

attributes.value: The value of the selected radio.

slots.default: The legend of the group, and its ful-radio children.

events.change: Fired with the value of the selected radio.

ful-table.description: A table that loads its rows from a loader, with sorting, pagination and an optional filter form. Its columns are declared in a schema slot.

slots.filters: Fields wrapped in a ful-form, submitted to filter the table.
slots.caption: The caption of the table.
slots.footer: Content rendered in the table footer.

ful-pagination.description: The pager of a ful-table. Rarely used on its own.

attributes.current: Zero based index of the page being shown.

events.page-requested: Fired with the zero based index of the page the user asked for.

ful-sorter.description: The sort control rendered in a ful-table header. Rarely used on its own.

attributes.order: The sort currently applied, asc or desc, or absent when unsorted.

events.sort-requested: Fired with the sorter and the next order when clicked.

ful-filter-instant.description: A ful-table filter over an instant, with an operator and one or two bounds.

attributes.value: JSON tuple of the operator and its bounds, for example ["BETWEEN", from, to].

events.change: Fired with the whole tuple, or undefined when the filter is incomplete.

ful-filter-local-date.description: A ful-table filter over a date, with an operator and one or two bounds.

attributes.value: JSON tuple of the operator and its bounds, for example ["BETWEEN", from, to].

events.change: Fired with the whole tuple, or undefined when the filter is incomplete.

ful-filter-text.description: A ful-table filter over text, with an operator such as CONTAINS or STARTS_WITH.

attributes.value: JSON tuple of the operator, the sensitivity and the text.

events.change: Fired with the whole tuple, or undefined when the filter is empty.

ful-select.description: A combobox backed by a loader, with badges for the current selection.

attributes.value: The selected key, or a comma separated list of keys when multiple.
attributes.itemlist: Shows the selection as a list under the control as well as badges.
attributes.k-type: The type every key is coerced to, both the assigned ones and the loader's: string (default), number or boolean. A key that does not decode, such as an empty string with number, is kept as it is.

slots.dropdown: Replaces the template used to render the options.

events.change: Fired with the selection, an array when multiple.

ful-dropdown.description: The options popup of a ful-select. Rarely used on its own.

events.change: Fired with the option that was picked.
